description: This pie chart represents the distribution of categories related to "Ever-scalingness" with four slices, each labeled and colored differently. The chart is divided into four segments: "Complexity" in yellow, occupying roughly 30% of the chart; "Instance" in blue, taking up around 25%; "Coverage" in green, making up approximately 25%; and "Scalable Oversight" in red, accounting for around 20%. The chart includes icons within each slice, and labels are placed outside the chart, connected to their corresponding slices, with "Uncrushable" linked to "Complexity", "Unhackable" to "Instance", "Auto-verifiable" to "Scalable Oversight", and "General" to "Coverage". No legend is present, and the slices appear to be arranged in a clockwise order without any particular visual emphasis.
